outcome: One screen that changes with the moment.

views.title: Climate
views.condition: Provide climate inputs to Ramka; pick up to ten rooms and their readings on the Ramka settings dashboard.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Air quality
views.condition: Provide air inputs and compatible air-quality readings to Ramka; each reading and its limits can be changed on the Ramka settings dashboard.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Plant care
views.condition: With plants 0.3.0, set plants: discover in Ramka (or list the plants). Up to six plants share a page by default; more turn in pages, the ones that need something first.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Photo slideshow
views.condition: Provide photo_dir and permit the directory in Home Assistant; albums, photos per series and time per photo are set on the Ramka settings dashboard.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Home status
views.condition: Enabled by default; turn it off on the Ramka settings dashboard or with status_page: false.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Room controls
views.condition: Approach or tap the tablet; lights and covers appear when configured.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Now playing
views.condition: A configured media player is playing. With audio-sensor and music_visual set, the wave strip draws the room's spectrum or level instead of the classic wave.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Calendar agenda
views.condition: Configure calendar entities and open the agenda.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Clock & weather
views.condition: Provide the weather entity to Ramka. Current weather appears with now playing; the configured climate page also includes a four-day forecast.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Set up the tablet and Companion app using the tablet guide.
Install the radar through Room presence and map its presence and distance entities.
Choose the optional page inputs, render the dashboard and check each configured page before deployment.
Add the Ramka settings dashboard's lovelace entry; pages, presence, display, photos, air limits, climate rooms, plants per page and the music visual are tuned there live, without a render.

states.label: Ambient
states.headline: A quiet view of your home
states.detail: The configured ambient pages rotate while someone is present.

states.label: Approach
states.headline: Controls within reach
states.detail: A nearby radar detection brings up controls when near controls are enabled.

states.label: Playing
states.headline: Let the music take the screen
states.detail: A playing media player takes priority over the ambient pages.

states.label: Away
states.headline: Rest until you return
states.detail: The tablet sleeps after the configured absence delay; this example skips the wait.
